readerEvidence.summary: Astra single-pass source recovery. All 4 Bulgarian question pages, all 21 older DOCX key pages and all 22 revised 30.07 PDF key pages personally read. Existing English transcription was a drafting aid, compared directly against supplied sources; no second model checker. Revised PDF is primary: recovers Q2, final-data Q10, both corrected Io methods Q13 and missing Q15 equations. Bulgarian wording/IDs remain; solutions remain English. Older DOCX retained as comparison source only; unrelated superseded proton-fusion task13 was not attached to Bulgarian Io13. Source discrepancies retained: Q2 reciprocal labels and intermediate ratios; Q3 0.995 and 86701.8; Q5 missing0.5 on right side; Q7 gravitational constant value/units; Q8 flux arithmetic; Q10 printed 2/5 m_H^2, Boltzmann exponent and frequency exponent; Q12 total versus kinetic energy mismatch; Q13 initial force arguments retain R_Io despite subsequent R_Io/2 and 3R_Io/8; Q15 positive arcsine value, longitude282°58′48, numerical polynomial and alternative results as printed.
sourceGaps: Задача 12: двата английски ключа задават кинетична енергия 1 GeV, а българското условие — пълна енергия 1 GeV; липсва официално решение за точно тази българска формулировка.
